entity.name: Domnic Amalan S
entity.description: Creator and maintainer of MedBrains, a free, open-source hospital management system built so that every hospital, big or small, has the tools to give safe care.

projects.name: MedBrains
projects.description: Free, open-source hospital management system: registration, OPD, wards, nursing, pharmacy, lab, radiology and billing on one patient record, with patient-safety checks built in (drug interactions, narcotics rules, barcode-verified medicine administration, critical lab alerts). Rust and PostgreSQL, with web and native iOS/Android apps. Supports ABDM, interoperable through HL7 FHIR R4, HL7 v2 and DICOM, and self-hostable so small, rural and charitable hospitals can run it at no licence cost.

channels.description: Bank transfer to the maintainer. Write to hello@medbrains.in for account details and an invoice.

plans.name: Core development and maintenance
plans.description: One year of full-time maintenance and development: security fixes and dependency updates, completing ABDM M2/M3 and HL7 FHIR write and search, LOINC mapping, a one-command install for hospitals, documentation, and reviewing community contributions.

plans.name: Go-live for a charitable hospital
plans.description: Setting up, migrating data and training staff so a charitable, trust or government hospital can go live on MedBrains at no cost to it.
